import (
	"strconv"

	"github.com/arturoeanton/go-dsl/pkg/dslbuilder"
)

calc := dslbuilder.New("Calc")
calc.Token("NUMBER", "[0-9]+")
calc.Token("PLUS", "\\+")
calc.Token("TIMES", "\\*")
calc.Rule("expr", []string{"NUMBER", "PLUS", "NUMBER"}, "add")
calc.Rule("expr", []string{"NUMBER", "TIMES", "NUMBER"}, "mul")

calc.Action("add", func(args []interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
	sa := args[0].(string)
	sb := args[2].(string)
	a, _ := strconv.Atoi(sa)
	b, _ := strconv.Atoi(sb)
	return a + b, nil
})
calc.Action("mul", func(args []interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
	sa := args[0].(string)
	sb := args[2].(string)
	a, _ := strconv.Atoi(sa)
	b, _ := strconv.Atoi(sb)
	return a * b, nil
})

sum, _ := calc.Parse("2+3")
prod, _ := calc.Parse("6*7")
sum.GetOutput()
prod.GetOutput()

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	gx "github.com/arturoeanton/go-xml/xml"
)

data := `<library>
	<book id="1"><title>El Principito</title><year>1943</year></book>
	<book id="2"><title>Rayuela</title><year>1963</year></book>
</library>`

m, err := gx.MapXML(strings.NewReader(data), gx.ForceArray("book"))
if err != nil {
	fmt.Println(err)
}

title, _ := gx.Query(m, "library/book/title/#text")
id, _ := gx.Query(m, "library/book/@id")
fmt.Println("first title:", title)
fmt.Println("first id:", id)
